subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value:
THE LIVE-ZERO COPY-FORM PROOF NOW HAS A THIRD MODE, `dominating_def_across_calls`, which crosses ONE interposed direct call. It exists because two lanes (CT and LZ) independently converged on refusing bl-crossing windows in v1 rather than baking an ABI assumption into a fail-closed guard, and the correct resolution of that standoff is not to relax `dominating_def` but to add a SEPARATELY NAMED mode whose weaker guarantee a rule must request explicitly. `dominating_def` still refuses these sites and is regression-pinned to do so, so no existing rule can drift onto the ABI-dependent proof merely because call_targets happens to be available.

WHAT IS MACHINE-CHECKED, four facts, all decided from the bytes and the relocation table before the scan steps over the word. (1) The copied source register is in r14-r31, the PPC EABI callee-saved set; a volatile source is refused outright. r13 is deliberately EXCLUDED even though it is preserved, because it is dedicated rather than allocatable and the set is meant to mean exactly 'registers a normal callee restores'. (2) The word is a direct `bl`: opcode 18 with LK set and AA clear. `bctrl` (opcode 19 xo 528 LK=1), `blrl` (xo 16 LK=1) and `bla` reach an address the scan cannot resolve to a symbol, and every conditional or non-linking branch is ordinary control flow rather than a call; all are refused, so the relaxation is strictly about CALLS and never about branches. (3) The call carries a REL24 relocation naming its callee - an unrelocated, already-bound call is unnameable and therefore unscreenable, and is refused. (4) THE TRAP THE CHECK EXISTS FOR: the named callee must not be MWCC's `_savegpr_N`/`_restgpr_N`/`_savefpr_N`/`_restfpr_N` millicode. That family deliberately writes the callee-saved range it is named for - `_restgpr_28` really does redefine r28-r31 - so it is the one class of direct call that breaks the very contract this mode relies on. Anyone tempted to reason 'a bl preserves non-volatiles, therefore any bl is crossable' has missed exactly this case; the existing `_helper_call` decoder already models the family for the recolor stage and is reused rather than re-derived.

THE RESIDUAL AXIOM, stated so it can never be taken silently: for a direct call to a named non-millicode symbol, the mode ASSUMES the callee honours the PPC EABI and restores r14-r31. That is a property of code outside the object being patched and is not derived from the bytes in front of the guard. It is the whole reason the mode is opt-in by name. Everything else about the scan is unchanged and still runs at every step: the entry-index check (so the span must still be straight-line and no back edge may re-enter), the redefinition check, and the constant-equality check - each has its own regression test exercised THROUGH a crossed call, so the relaxation cannot silently swallow a second obligation.

SCOPE HONESTY: this mode does NOT address the destination-mismatch case. A site whose form differs AND whose destination registers differ (LZ's measured v2 requirement, camera_mode_level +0x8b0, target `mr r29,r30` against our `li r27,0`) is still refused by name as a recolor, and remains unreachable until a genuinely combined form-plus-renaming pass exists. Adding call-crossing did not bring that case any closer.
